items.title: Bobby Militello interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 14, 2002
items.q: And I went outside and I was almost having like a panic attack, and I started crying, telling my brother... 'Michael, if I do that then I become the singer that plays saxophone.'

ctx.x: Well remember, we were fairly poor. And I’m the baby and so my sister had moved out by then and brother Charlie had moved out by then, and Michael was just about to move © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
out, and so bringing in a hundred sixty a week and a sophomore in high school helped out a lot. And I had my own car and things like that, I mean it was a pretty good situation.
